ph: Swamishri with the Governer of Gujarat

w: In the evening assembly, Swamishri witnessed a beautifully choreographed 35 minute dance presentation, 'Sabrang', by children and youth members. During his blessings Swamishri said, "If one remembers God then one's mind will become calm and peaceful. You should study your very best, and do your homework properly. By studying well, you will be able to support your parents, serve society and the nation in the future. And by offering devotion to God you will be blessed with happiness and redemption…"
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha at the newly inaugurated Swaminarayan Mandir.
During late afternoon Swamishri arrived at Kheralu and performed the foundation-stone laying ceremony for a new mandir.
At 7.45pm Swamishri arrived in Modasa and was welcomed by devotees and dignitaries.

At 11.00 am, the Lt. Governor of New Delhi, Shri Vijay Kapoor, visited the Akshardham site. He was highly impressed by the quality and pace of construction of the Akshardham monument. He met Swamishri and expressed his joy about the construction work.
Swamishri arrived in Gadhada at 6.40 p.m. Here, Swamishri had darshan at the Shri Hari Smruti Mandir, where Shriji Maharaj was cremated, and other sanctified spots.
At 10.25 am Swamishri departed from Bhavnagar and arrived in Sarangpur via Vallabhipur at 11.35 am.

In the evening Swamishri attended an assembly of 4,375 volunteers who had come to serve in the rangotsav the next day. Swamishri blessed them by inspiring them to sincerely serve the devotees the next day, “Who purifies us! It is the Gunatit Sadhu. Our mother is Gunatitanand Swami, Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj. They purify us through their divine discourses. They free us from addictions and base nature and make us pure. Thereafter Maharaj embraces us and blesses us with the happiness of Akshardham. To attain this we have mandirs, festivals and spiritual discourses. By sitting inside the mandir we are freed of worldly inclinations and attachment for the body. We are also redeemed of a faultfinding attitude and learn to appreciate each others virtues. “Sevak means one who is a servant of servants. Only then does one derives happiness. But if one comes here as a boss, then one can never experience inner joy. We all have to become servants. A volunteer does not need any praise or glory. We should focus on serving others.”

At 7.35 pm Swamishri first performed pujan of and then sprayed coloured water on Harikrishna Maharaj. Thereafter everyone performed arti of Thakorji. Finally Swamishri showered coloured holy water on the volunteers.
Pramukh Swami Maharaj was doing darshan of Harikrishna Maharaj. Harishbhai Bhupatani, who had come from Uganda, asked Swamishri, "How should we do darshan?"
Answering in a single sentence, Swamishri said, "If we forget ourselves and do darshan of God, happiness comes."

ds.t: Remember Maharaj and write your exam
w: After the meal Swamishri blessed a student on the phone. This student, who had scored 93% in tenth grade, had become so anxious about the coming twelfth grade board exams that, though bright, he had lost confidence, and the inner strain had brought on a fit. Two days before the board exams, blessing the boy who had lost heart, Swamishri said, "Remember Maharaj and give the exam. Maharaj will be kind. Pray. We will pray too. What you have learned you will write properly, and you will pass with good marks."
With these few words of Swamishri his courage grew, he sat the exam, and he got good marks too.
